question.knowledge_point: Solving for a Vector in a Linear Combination
question.worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}2a+4x & =b \\ 4x & =b-2a \\ x & =\frac{1}{4}(b-2a) \\ x & =\frac{1}{4}([\begin{aligned}14 \\ 2 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-2[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -3 \\ 1 \\ 6\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =\frac{1}{4}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 8 \\ -4 \\ -12\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -1 \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
